tools.name: gorelo_list_clients
tools.description: List the MSP's clients (customers). Good first call to find a client id. API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: gorelo_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id with its details. API: GET /v1/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: gorelo_list_client_locations
tools.description: List the locations (sites) of one client. API: GET /v1/clients/{clientId}/locations.

tools.name: gorelo_list_contacts
tools.description: List client contacts (end users). API: GET /v1/contacts.

tools.name: gorelo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id. API: GET /v1/contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: gorelo_list_tickets
tools.description: List service tickets, newest activity first, with status, priority, client, assignees and SLA. Use the list_ticket_statuses/types/priorities tools to learn the ids for filters. API: GET /v1/tickets.

tools.name: gorelo_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by id (uuid). API: GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: gorelo_list_ticket_comments
tools.description: List the comments (public replies, private notes) on a ticket. API: GET /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: gorelo_list_ticket_statuses
tools.description: List the ticket statuses (id and name) used to filter or update tickets. API: GET /v1/tickets/statuses.

tools.name: gorelo_list_ticket_types
tools.description: List the ticket types. API: GET /v1/tickets/types.

tools.name: gorelo_list_ticket_priorities
tools.description: List the ticket priorities. API: GET /v1/tickets/priorities.

tools.name: gorelo_list_agent_assets
tools.description: List agent (RMM managed device) assets with status, OS and client. API: GET /v1/assets/agents.

tools.name: gorelo_get_agent_asset
tools.description: Get one managed device by id (guid). API: GET /v1/assets/agents/{agentAssetId}.

tools.name: gorelo_get_agent_hardware
tools.description: Get a managed device's processors, memory and disks. API: GET /v1/assets/agents/{agentAssetId}/hardware.

tools.name: gorelo_list_agent_pending_updates
tools.description: List the Windows updates pending on a managed device, from its last scan (no new scan starts). API: GET /v1/assets/agents/{agentAssetId}/patches/available.

tools.name: gorelo_list_custom_assets
tools.description: List custom (non-agent) assets such as printers, switches and licences. API: GET /v1/assets/custom.

tools.name: gorelo_list_alerts
tools.description: List alerts (uptime, script, external, ...) newest first. API: GET /v1/alerts.

tools.name: gorelo_get_alert
tools.description: Get one alert by id (guid). API: GET /v1/alerts/{alertId}.

tools.name: gorelo_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with status, client and lead. API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: gorelo_list_project_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one project. API: GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks.

tools.name: gorelo_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged time across tickets and tasks. API: GET /v1/time-entries.

tools.name: gorelo_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status, totals and client. API: GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: gorelo_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its line items and attachments. API: GET /v1/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: gorelo_list_contracts
tools.description: List billing contracts with their service lines. API: GET /v1/contracts.

tools.name: gorelo_list_users
tools.description: List users (technicians) with role and status; use their ids as assignee ids. API: GET /v1/organization/users.

tools.name: gorelo_list_groups
tools.description: List technician groups (ids are needed to create a ticket). API: GET /v1/organization/groups.

tools.name: gorelo_create_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: create a service ticket. Needs status_id, group_id and type_id (use gorelo_list_ticket_statuses, gorelo_list_groups, gorelo_list_ticket_types). Set send_created_email true only if the contact must get a 'ticket created' email. API: POST /v1/tickets.

tools.name: gorelo_update_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a ticket (status, priority, assignee, title, tags). Only the fields you send change. Each change notifies and logs as in the app. Changing the client clears the ticket's contact and assets. API: PATCH /v1/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: gorelo_add_ticket_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to a ticket's main thread. A 'public' comment is a reply the client sees and may be emailed to them; a 'private' comment is an internal note. Do not retry after an unclear error: that can post twice. API: POST /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: gorelo_update_alert_status
tools.description: WRITE: dismiss an alert, restore it to New, or link it to an open ticket (status 'ticketed' needs ticket_id). The change applies to the alert's whole stack, as in the app. API: PATCH /v1/alerts/{alertId}.

tools.name: gorelo_log_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: log work time against a ticket (or a project task). Give any two of started_on, ended_on and actual_hours (the API derives the third). Billing role, work type and billable status default from the ticket. Do not retry after an unclear error: that can log twice. API: POST /v1/time-entries.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gorelo_list_tickets, gorelo_get_ticket, gorelo_list_ticket_comments, gorelo_list_ticket_statuses, gorelo_list_ticket_types, gorelo_list_ticket_priorities, gorelo_list_time_entries, gorelo_list_groups, gorelo_create_ticket, gorelo_update_alert_status · Private data: gorelo_list_contacts, gorelo_get_contact, gorelo_list_ticket_comments, gorelo_create_ticket, gorelo_update_ticket, gorelo_add_ticket_comment · Public sink: gorelo_create_ticket, gorelo_update_ticket, gorelo_add_ticket_comment, gorelo_log_time_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gorelo_list_tickets, gorelo_get_ticket, gorelo_list_ticket_comments, gorelo_list_ticket_statuses, gorelo_list_ticket_types, gorelo_list_ticket_priorities, gorelo_list_time_entries, gorelo_list_groups, gorelo_create_ticket, gorelo_update_alert_status · Private data: gorelo_list_contacts, gorelo_get_contact, gorelo_list_ticket_comments, gorelo_create_ticket, gorelo_update_ticket, gorelo_add_ticket_comment · Public sink: gorelo_create_ticket, gorelo_update_ticket, gorelo_add_ticket_comment, gorelo_log_time_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
